rules.body: Apply when immediate document writes become reusable trailing work, document buffers outlive visible subscriptions, and save callbacks can synchronously navigate. Confirm any departure deadline separately. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

Bind accepted edits to their originating document's reusable trailing task, replace pending text, restart the quiet interval on every edit, and preserve the no-current-view guard. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet
interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts
must continue to save." src/coordinator.js: "trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text))". src/services.js: "push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); },"

Clear the consumed batch before invoking callback-capable saving, preserving new edits queued by synchronous callback reentry. Preserve empty text as valid work; do not replace the null check with a truthiness check or clear pending work after the callback. src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };"

Separate persistent document work from subscription cleanup. View retirement must not discard accepted edits or destroy reusable per-document tasks. docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." Survival does not alone mandate immediate flushing on departure; establish any such deadline independently.

Preserve navigation authority around callback-capable saving. Capture the departing view, release current ownership before retirement callbacks, and clean up the captured subscription without clearing a newer view afterward. Retain the request check before installing an opening. src/coordinator.js: "const old=getView();setView(null);" and "const mine=++request;retire();if(true&&mine!==request)return;" docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." If departure-time saving is added, ensure subsequent outer mutations cannot overwrite nested navigation; place saving after final retirement mutations or recheck authority before continuing.

Preserve public interfaces, document display, live status filtering, and document identity, text, and status payload semantics. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." src/coordinator.js: "if(event.id===id)env.renderStatus(event);" Verify coordinator cleanup through the supplied React integration as well: src/Workspace.jsx contains "useEffect(()=>api.dispose,[api]);".

Keep transient search preview outside the repair, including its 40 ms delay, discard on hide, and subsequent reuse. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};" Do not transfer persistent document ownership policy to preview or change its behavior through shared-utility edits.

Use controlled time to check no immediate write, latest text only after 120 ms of quiet, deadline restart, subsequent bursts, empty text, originating-document binding, and independent document buffers. Exercise switch, close, dispose, same-document reopening, subscription cleanup, save-triggered open/close, and callback-enqueued edits. Verify cleanup through both coordinator calls and React effect cleanup. Check preview delay, hide cancellation, and reuse. Require accepted document work to survive retirement; assert persistence before departure returns only with independent normative support. These checks derive from TASK's "Subsequent bursts
must continue to save." and "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces.", together with the ownership, callback, and utility evidence above; evaluation observations remain examples.

limitations: Independent buffer ownership requires accepted work to survive view retirement; it does not independently establish a deadline requiring a save before departure returns. The automatic Contract and evaluation observations cannot establish that deadline.

Attempt 1 uses departure-time flushing and reportedly passes the supplied observations. This is one implementation example, not proof of causality, exhaustive correctness, or cross-task effectiveness.
Synchronous timer startup, callbacks after cancellation, callback exceptions, write failures, and permanent disposal semantics are unspecified.

The subscription experiences concern bootstrap delivery, asynchronous decoding, arrival ordering, audit retention, and retry queues. Those mechanisms are absent from this task and supply no additional obligations.
This reflection uses supplied material only; no files were modified and no scorer, reference implementation, or hidden tests were accessed.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
